runsheet.short_description: In each of the 4 on-site rooms, log the room computer into the Zoom Meeting as its own account, renamed to the room name (e.g. "Room A (on-site)"). Check camera, mic and speakers.
Pre-create 4 breakout rooms named after the on-site rooms. Make the 4 hosts co-hosts so they can move between rooms if needed.
Opening plenary (main room): introduce the proposed topics from Dotstorming and form the groups, one per room.
During the plenary, bring the mic to on-site participants who speak.
Assign each on-site room account to its breakout room, open the breakout rooms, and allow online participants to choose their room.
Go to your on-site room. Facilitate ~45 min of discussion, balancing on-site and online participation.
Broadcast a 5-minute warning to all breakout rooms; then close the breakout rooms so everyone returns to the main room.
Make a concluding statement to everyone, on-site and online.
